state: known resource; unknown pass-through; withheld; read failure; body and argument preservation
locale_path: Selected installed content-policy transform adds fixed English withholding fallbacks.
source_finding: The session matches /skill: by prefix and splits the name at a literal space. Unknown names pass through. Known skills read through contentPolicy when present; a non-string result yields TextGuard withheld this skill pending user review. A policy read exception yields TextGuard could not check this skill; content withheld. Without policy the error is emitted as skill_expansion and input passes through. Frontmatter is removed; body/path/base directory and trailing user arguments form preserved prompt content.
coverage_limit: No skill executed or provider invoked; nested prompt content is not a translated screen; getEnableSkillCommands gates suggestions but not this expansion branch.

state: start/midline completion; no matches; direct submit transform; escaped dollar; extension-source bypass
locale_path: Resource descriptions are forwarded by the selected completion wrapper; no package locale hook.
source_finding: Completion filters pi.getCommands entries with source skill and labels them $name. A prompt-start completion uses a slash-shaped prefix and inserts /skill:name; midline completion inserts without the same submit gesture. Direct dollar input matching the bounded lowercase/hyphen grammar transforms to /skill:name without checking existence. Escaped dollar loses its escape rather than invoking a skill; extension-origin input bypasses this transform. Unknown transformed skills subsequently follow Pi pass-through behavior.
coverage_limit: No keystrokes executed; arbitrary matching names remain a grammar boundary rather than additional shipped named routes; no model response is certified.

locale_path: Template body is preserved prompt content; description fallback is the first nonempty body line truncated at 60 characters.
source_finding: Core profile selects prompts/jouzu-review.md. The resource loader derives the command name from the basename; expansion matches an admitted template and substitutes positional/all-argument/default forms without recursively substituting argument contents. The shipped review template has no frontmatter description and no argument placeholder; its body is the command description fallback and prompt content. It is not itself a review-result screen.
coverage_limit: Profile materialization/resource admission is conditional; no review or model request run; arbitrary external prompt files excluded.

entry_point: leading fullwidth slash before a selected slash route
state: trimmed submit normalization; first-line completion; ASCII-only interception bypass
locale_path: Routing and source payload boundary; no locale transformation of argument content.
source_finding: Native onSubmit trims and changes the first fullwidth slash to ASCII before builtin dispatch and downstream extension/resource handling. Completion normalizes only the first editor line with a leading fullwidth slash. Session UI tests its /model regular expression and exact /scoped-models text before calling super.handleInput; raw fullwidth forms do not match those interceptors and can reach the native handlers. Completion may instead replace a form with ASCII before submit. This is a source-selected consumer difference rather than proof that both gestures render the same screen.
coverage_limit: No IME/terminal gestures executed; arguments and case are not generally normalized; arbitrary malformed spellings remain ordinary input.

Without that context it returns false and Session UI restores the original input for Pi's native scoped-model selector. Caught rejection follows the same fallback; native families remain separate.

Names and tmux identities remain preserved values; these controls are not just description text.
